description: Patch one owned moment by moment_id (from log_moment); fields left out are untouched. It stays private. Requires moment_id. Patchable: title, description, moment_date, moment_date_precision, end_date, moment_type, location_name, people, event_id, images, tags. Unknown or other-user moment_id returns an error and creates nothing. person_ids / people_names, media_urls and tags replace the stored list ([] clears); event_id links an owned event (the event is not changed), empty or null unlinks. Visibility is not an argument. Returns changed_fields. Requires API key or OAuth with context.write. ($0.10; API key required)

cover_image_url.description: https image link. Empty or null clears.

description.description: Replaces the story text. Empty or null clears.

event_id.description: Link the moment to an owned event (the event is not changed). Empty or null unlinks.

location_name.description: Replaces the place. Empty or null clears. Alias: location.

moment_date_precision.description: How exact the date is. YYYY-MM and YYYY default to month and year; circa for "around then".

moment_id.description: UUID of a moment the user owns (from log_moment).

people_names.description: Replaces the tagged people (with person_ids); names match saved contacts only.

person_ids.description: Replaces the tagged people (with people_names). [] clears. Owned contact ids only.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

name: update_moment

changed_fields.description: The columns this call changed; empty when nothing differed.

moment.description: A moment: a story or memory, private to the owner. event_id links the event it is about.

moment_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (the first day of the month or year for a soft date).

visibility.description: Always private for a moment an agent saves.

items.description: A Dayze person or contact record.

title: Update Moment (patch a story)
